Interface MergePolicy

public interface MergePolicy
Decides whether a storage holding one variant of a type may accept another variant of the same type, and what the stored variant becomes (ARCHITECTURE.md §9.2). Different types never merge, whatever the policy says.

Implementations must be deterministic and must not use floating point.

    • weightedAverage

      @NotNull static @NotNull MergePolicy weightedAverage(@NotNull @NotNull ResourceComponentType<Long> component)
      Merges variants that differ only in component, replacing it by the amount-weighted average (rounded down). Example: mixing 100 mB of steam at 400 K into 300 mB at 300 K gives 400 mB at 325 K.
